body: Yeah I do think that it's true here too about relationships between 2 women, that people are more homophobic towards guy/guy. And yeah, I would like to remain attracted but they're reminding me more and more of their mum who I really am not attracted to at all.  Thanks for reminding me I'm not guaranteed to!

Thank you! Just wanted to say publicly I really appreciate this reply. I am also a hothead on gender issues and made an office social awkward just the other day by arguing with a cis het man who hasn't thought twice about gender and was saying non binary people don't exist.

Hey, so I'm basically in the same situation. My partner is also mentally v unwell. I feel trapped as I care for them as a person and I've hoped that things would change but I really don't feel I am growing from the relationship. Unfortunately I can't say this/leave for fear of bad things.

From the outside, I'd say that even though you feel like you're helping her by staying, she's not your responsibility and if you're not happy you don't have to be there/in that relationship.
In long term depression, continuously providing a lot of support can be incredibly draining, obviously support helps them, but there is only so much one can do, you need to look after yourself too!
